rows.en: Shaider, the manufacturer is on this silicon board…
Japan Future Electronics Industries? I see! Now I get it! That's where the factory is.
All riiight, let's smash it!

That's Japan Future Electronics Industries… Fuuma's secret factory!

It was hidden among TDF-related facilities! To fool our eyes…
Makuu!? Why?

You Space Sheriffs… So you saw through it? But it's too late!

The Earthlings have stopped going to school or work and become sloths! Our Makuu and Fuuma will conquer the Earth! Ha ha ha…
Damn… We won't let you do as you please any longer! Sekisha!!
Johchaku!!
Grr, impudent… You Space Sheriffs!! Attack!!
Armoring up!!
Guh…
Hyah…
Captain Gavan! The Security Unit has just arrived!

Thanks!

We'll handle Makuu… The Security Unit, please take over the factory!

Thanks!

We'll handle Makuu… The Security Unit, please take over the factory!
Roger! We'll take over Japan Future Electronics Industries.

What!? The Space Sheriffs found our secret factory!?

Grr… Begin Operation Makuu Cram School!

Keep feeding Madako Food to the depraved Earthlings' children, and raise them into Beast Alien Doublemen!

Choose the children with superior strength and intellect, create Elite Doublemen, and make them our fighting force!

Sir! I've already taken steps.

We've made a depraved Earthling the head of the Super Genius Cram School, had him gather children, and are educating them now.

Heh heh heh…

Now, now, everyone… If you study here while you play, anyone can become a super genius!

Well then, let's do some arithmetic!

Today's exercise is dividing decimals. Work out the answer past the decimal point, and give the remainder too.
Teacher! I'm done.

Oho, let's see…

All correct! Masaru, you're a genius! Ha ha ha…

Now, everyone… It's time for a yummy, yummy school lunch!

Today's treat is… Madako Food, which makes your brain work better! Go on, eat up.

This Madako Food feeds your brain cells and makes them spin faster. Come on, come on, eat, eat…

Boy… That was a real mess I got into, huh?

The Yumecon was so handy that I lost all will to do anything… Thanks to that, the shop's in this state.
Hee hee… If it's cleaning, I'll help.
I don't mind helping with the cleaning.

Thanks…

More importantly… I hear children are vanishing one after another from parents who've lost all their drive!

Yes…

We've picked up that information too!
And they're picking out the children with superior strength and intellect… the so-called geniuses.
Oh!? Masaru, you're on your own today?
My sister's busy with research and development at the TDF…

I see…

Well then… I'll treat you to my special curry! Don't be shy, eat up…
I wonder if Masaru is all right?
Yeah… It's worrying that he's on his own, huh?
Masaru's fine, right?
What… do you mean by that?
Huh? I didn't mean anything…
…? What's wrong, Masaru?

…………

I can't eat this gross stuff! I want to eat Madako Food!
Madako Food?
Masaru!? Don't tell me…?
Wait! Masaru!
I'll follow Masaru!
Well? Is it going well?

Sir…

With Hunter Killer's cooperation, the children are gathering one after another at Makuu's Super Genius Cram School!
I don't care for rough tactics… but if they're necessary, it can't be helped.
Right now, at the Super Genius Cram School, we're having them drink Fuuma Hormone Drink to polish their intellect and strength even further.
Half of them will become Makuu's Beast Alien Doublemen, but the other half… How I look forward to 10 years from now…
Fuuma intends to build up the kidnapped genius boys' strength with Fuuma's hormones, drill Fuuma's teachings into them, and send them back to their homes.
In 10 years, grown up, they will rise to prominence in every field of Japan's scholarship, politics and sports…
It will be as good as Fuuma, Makuu and Madou ruling Japan.
Commander Hessler! Kidnap more and more children!
Leave it to me…
How's this?
OK!
Wow… So it's true what they say about women transforming themselves with makeup.
I don't transform. I probably… can't even do makeup.

…………

No, sorry. I just pictured it…
…Looks like you've got something to say?
Well, [HERO4]… can you transform yourself like that? Or are you already in disguise? I was just wondering…
What's that supposed to mean…?
Shaider? What are you starting?

Anyway, Annie's tailing found out that Masaru has been going in and out of a place called the Super Genius Cram School!

We want to rescue the abducted children, but we don't know what it's like inside…

So the plan is for Annie to disguise herself as a teacher at the school and go undercover in the Super Genius Cram School.

I see…

The children are as good as hostages, so we can't move carelessly!

So their real target was the children…

It's a plan to corrupt the parents with the Yumecon, put them off guard, and kidnap the children en masse!
What a vile tactic! I won't forgive them!
So that's the Super Genius Cram School…

Makuu!?

Just as I thought, it's heavily guarded! I'll attack from behind! Sharivan and Shaider, split into two groups and attack from behind too!
Yes, Captain!
Annie, I'm counting on you! Slip in without being noticed!
OK!!
So you've shown up, Gavan!
Hunter Killer!!

…!?

Madou!? General Guiler!
Eliminate them!!
I won't let you!!
Grr… Damn you, Sharivan! Don't underestimate me…!
General Guiler, I leave the rest to you!
Grr… You Space Sheriffs! Don't think this means you've won.
Now's my chance…
It worked! We got Annie inside!

uncertain: U09308: [HERO4] 装着します rendered "Armoring up!!" (cf. 装着 in U07407).
U09315/U09345: [ja] rendered "raise them into Beast Alien Doublemen" (plural).
U09316: [ja] — the depraved Earthling is Hanpei Hattori (U09317); "him".
U09353-U09358: 女は化ける pun (women "transform" with makeup); [HERO4] (android-type in route 1) takes it literally. Rendered with "transform".
U09365: Gavan says both he and the others attack 後ろから; one may have meant 正面 (front). Translated literally.
